name: changelog
body: A repo-root `CHANGELOG.md`, in Keep-a-Changelog style, with an `Unreleased` section that records every user-visible change before it is released. Every user-visible change — a new command or flag, a format or behaviour change, a user-facing fix, a new author-guide or documentation surface — is recorded under `[Unreleased]` as it lands, grouped under `Added`/`Changed`/`Fixed`/`Removed`/`Deprecated`/`Security` as Keep a Changelog defines them; a release renames the section to the released version and its entry summarises that release. AC: `CHANGELOG.md` exists at the repo root with an `Unreleased` heading; every user-visible change has an entry under `[Unreleased]` (including the layered-library, section-helper `child`/`children`, `{{ template }}` layout-composition example-check fix, `AGENTS_KALIDE.md` author-guide scheme and docs changes); before a version tag is pushed, the `Unreleased` entry summarising that release is complete.
